beats.body:
The gate log is here: `gate_log` has every entry and exit at the hotel's three gates —
**MAIN**, **SERVICE** and **STAFF** — since noon.
Each row has the gate, direction (IN/OUT), time, vehicle number, vehicle colour, and sometimes a name the guard wrote down.

Comparison operators help us filter rows:

| Operator | Description |
|---|---|
| `=` | Equal to |
| `<>` | Not equal to |
| `<` | Less than |
| `<=` | Less than or equal to |
| `>` | Greater than |
| `>=` | Greater than or equal to |

Tip: our times look like `'2026-12-12 18:00:00'`. In this format, a later time is "greater", so `>=` works on times too.
